title: Dynamite Stick x7
body:
"Can be used to output a large explosion, with a large range. Any dynamite sticks which blow up other explosives will have a chain reaction, and explosives can be used to chop trees or break ores."

Description

The Dynamite Stick x7 has a powerful explosion, and a large radius. Like any other explosive, it damages trees and ores, and can be used to open the gate at the Skull Rock to get the Skull.

Unlike bombs, dynamite blows up almost instantly in a chain reaction.

The Dynamite Stick x7 can be bought from the Pirate Boat and Dugg's Digging.

Trivia

● This item was originally priced at $7,500.
